notes: receiptVectors: receiptJson (UTF-8 text) or receiptBase64 are the signed bytes, run through the DISPATCHING validator (v3 when the bytes claim "v":3, otherwise v2) with the same context shape as test-vectors.json.

The v3 validator does not compare policyVersion with anything (expected.policyVersion is ignored). basis "policy" is refused with code basis_action for every action outside POLICY_BASIS_ACTIONS (no attestation) and ATTESTED_POLICY_BASIS_ACTIONS (environment.start only: environment.create is never attested and always needs a person).

attestationDigest is the one OPTIONAL v3 field: it must be present exactly when basis is "policy" and the action is environment.start, and absent otherwise (code attestation, field attestationDigest). Its shape is the policyVersion hash shape. An attested start must also name the VM in its action args: args.vmId, a lowercase GUID (code attestation, field vmId).

policyVectors: parse json with the strict reader (depth 2) as a tier policy. ok:false means rejected; otherwise canonicalJson is the compact file form, hash the policy hash (a receipt v3 policyVersion; hash domain albera.policy-hash.v2), noPrompt the actions that need no person and attestedNoPrompt the actions that need none only with a valid Broker network attestation of "none".

loosenVectors: loosens is true when moving from one policy to the other lets an action skip a person (with or without an attestation) that could not skip before (that is what needs a presence signature).

Both the Node and C# implementations must reproduce every expected value. The policy hash is defined in TierPolicy.cs; the signed policy message is albera.policy.v1 0x00 kid 0x00 audience 0x00 hash (policyMessage.cases), bound to one Authority by its kid and audience.
